ranking_methodology: Ranked by customer comment/evidence volume (descending count of supporting customer records)

ranked_opportunities.theme_name: Price Drop Sensitivity & EORS Sale Triggers
ranked_opportunities.description: Wishlist usage as a passive price-monitoring tracker where items sit for 30-60 days waiting for flash price drops and EORS discounts.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Waiting for price drops is a primary driver of cart abandonment as users deliberately withhold immediate purchase intent, directly suppressing baseline daily gross merchandise value (GMV) until margin-diluting discount events occur.

ranked_opportunities.description: Inconsistent size charts across international and domestic brands (e.g. Mango vs Tokyo Talkies) creating severe return hesitation.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Sizing anxiety creates severe cognitive friction, directly halting checkout conversion out of fear of cumbersome return loops and refund turnaround times.

ranked_opportunities.theme_name: Social Validation & Unedited Real-Life Photo Proof
ranked_opportunities.description: Studio lighting and heavily edited model photos creating deep suspicion about actual fabric colors, drape, and sheerness.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Distrust in studio-edited visuals stalls conversion as users demand authentic, user-generated proof of fabric quality and fit before committing funds.

ranked_opportunities.theme_name: Competitor Cross-App Arbitrage & Price Matching (AJIO, Nykaa, Zara)
ranked_opportunities.description: Shoppers use Myntra's superior search UI to discover and wishlist items, but purchase them on competitor platforms offering cheaper coupons.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Cross-platform price arbitration leads to direct customer leakage and lost revenue to aggressive competitor app promotions immediately after discovery on Myntra.

ranked_opportunities.theme_name: Wishlist as Pre-Cart & Impulse Cooling-Off Buffer
ranked_opportunities.description: Shoppers intentionally park fashion items in the wishlist for 7-14 days to let initial impulse enthusiasm cool down and maintain monthly budget discipline.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Intentional cooling-off periods temporarily delay immediate impulse conversions, acting as a natural psychological barrier against spontaneous end-of-month checkouts.

ranked_opportunities.description: Lack of in-app side-by-side comparison matrix forcing shoppers to use desktop multi-tabs or manual paper notes to evaluate similar items.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Comparison friction creates mild user frustration and delays decision-making, though it rarely prevents an eventual purchase if intent is already high.

ranked_opportunities.theme_name: Event Planning Horizons & Size Stock-Out Anxiety
ranked_opportunities.description: Shoppers bookmark outfits 2-3 months ahead of weddings or trips, only to find their size permanently sold out when they are finally ready to purchase.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Delayed purchase horizons directly translate into lost conversions via permanent out-of-stock events, resulting in stock-out drop-offs and missed seasonal sales peaks.

ranked_opportunities.theme_name: Visual Clutter Paralysis & Wishlist Maintenance (1,000-Item Cap)
ranked_opportunities.description: Disorganized, un-categorized wishlist interfaces cluttered with out-of-stock items, hitting the 1,000-item cap and causing search fatigue.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Wishlist clutter and item caps induce decision fatigue, leading users to abandon browsing sessions entirely rather than clean out or convert saved inventory.

ranked_opportunities.theme_name: Desire Decay, Novelty Fading & Stale Wishlist Forgetting
ranked_opportunities.description: After 2-4 weeks, the initial emotional enthusiasm completely evaporates; without smart re-engagement nudges, saved items sit forgotten indefinitely.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: Desire decay results in permanent cart abandonment as emotional attachment to saved fashion items naturally wanes over time without proactive algorithmic nudges.

ranked_opportunities.theme_name: Social Reassurance Delays & Off-Platform Peer Validation
ranked_opportunities.description: Shoppers pause checkout for days waiting for feedback from family, friends, or partners on WhatsApp screenshots.
ranked_opportunities.purchase_delay_reasoning: External validation dependencies introduce multi-day checkout delays, creating windows of opportunity for users to lose interest or purchase elsewhere.
